query: 负责任营销政策 负责任营销政策 衡量企业营销活动在真实性、透明度、社会价值引导及弱势群体保护方面的规范程度。重点考察预防误导宣传、保护未成年人、广告审查流程及违规问责机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的负责任营销准则；包含明确的“禁误导/夸大”红线；针对未成年人或其他弱势群体有专项保护机制；设有独立的多级内容审查流程（如合规或法务会签）；具备明确的虚假宣传违规问责与纠偏机制。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的广告管理制度或包含在员工行为准则中，具备基础的真实性要求和法务审核环节，但缺乏针对未成年人等特定群体的保护细节或系统的问责逻辑。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“诚信经营”等口头表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：负责任营销政策覆盖 >80% 的产品线、业务单元、销售地区及所有营销渠道（含新媒体、直播、线下广告）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对大众传播而忽略了经销商、KOL 推广等私域场景，或未披露覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 负责任营销 广告规范 禁止误导宣传 未成年人保护 营销合规审查 广告审批 虚假宣传问责 responsible marketing advertising standards misleading claims protection of minors marketing compliance review advertising approval false advertising accountability 是否有负责任营销或广告管理制度？ 是否明确禁止误导/夸大宣传？ 对未成年人或其他弱势群体有哪些专项保护？ 内容审查是否含合规/法务多级会签？ 虚假宣传的问责与纠偏机制是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '负责任营销政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有负责任营销或广告管理制度？ 是否明确禁止误导/夸大宣传？ 对未成年人或其他弱势群体有哪些专项保护？ 内容审查是否含合规/法务多级会签？ 虚假宣传的问责与纠偏机制是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“诚信经营”口号；仅有产品标签合规说明；仅有品牌传播案例；仅有客户隐私政策；区分：负责任营销规范宣传内容与受众保护；产品标签关注包装说明书信息披露；二者都涉及真实性，但场景与载体不同。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Approach to Sustainability / Preventing Illegal Acts
results.text: The Group established the Whistle-blowing Policy to support the identification and report of any suspicious cases of unethical business conduct or misbehaviour have developed a whistle-blowing system along with the policy to provide a channel for employees and business partners to report or submit a grievance on any misconduct malpractices. [Content]
The Group established the Whistle-blowing Policy to support the identification and report of any suspicious cases of unethical business conduct or misbehaviour have developed a whistle-blowing system along with the policy to provide a channel for employees and business partners to report or submit a grievance on any misconduct malpractices. results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: The Group strictly follows labour laws and regulations in areas where it operates and prohibits any form of child labour or forced labour. To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods. We would never force employees to work against their wills with violence or intimidation, or by restricting their freedom. To avoid child labour, the Group requires candidates to provide proof of identity and candidates without a valid identity proof would not be considered. In case of child labour and forced labour are discovered, the Group will take immediately actions to stop such from happening.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / 5.2.2. Focusing on Employee Engagement
results.text: The Group issues the Implementation Guide of Talent Development and Management to establish mentorship programme for new recruits. When new recruit is on board, dual mentors, including an integrated mentor and a job-specific mentor, are assigned to each new employee. The integrated mentor is responsible for the training and development of employees' integrated capabilities and providing guidance on career path planning, while the job-specific mentor is responsible for providing training on job duties. To equip employees with the skill set that they need for their roles, the Group proactively provides a wide range of business and function-specific training to empower employees' growth and performance.
